nodes.label: EngSpace Tools master blueprint (TOOLS-BLUEPRINT.md)
nodes.rationale: Field-first, office-complete lens: build for site engineers, supervisors, foremen and trades who work offline, one-thumbed, gloved, in sun and noise; rank tools by daily use x minutes saved on site, then make the daily field tools the best in the market. Three independent reviews (engineering, codebase, product) were applied before code.

nodes.label: Confidence tags [H]/[M]/[L] and «⚑ تحقق» flag
nodes.rationale: Every [L] value ships as a configurable default with a visible «⚑ تحقق» note on screen and in the PDF, never a hard rule.

nodes.label: «اليوم في الموقع» Today-on-site strip
nodes.rationale: Principle 1: the site day is the unit of design. Built from toolIndex headers only, so it loads no tool chunk; groups items by project because inspectors cover several sites.

nodes.label: Field mode (56 px targets, html[data-field])
nodes.rationale: Principle 2: one thumb, gloves and sun: 56 px targets (48 px elsewhere), steppers for counts, typed values instead of long pickers, a ± key because the iOS decimal pad has no minus, nothing needs a swipe.

nodes.label: Sun mode «وضع الشمس» (≥ 7:1 contrast)
nodes.rationale: Dark UIs wash out in direct sun: a one-tap toggle in every ToolHero forces the light theme, thickens borders and raises weights so load-bearing text reaches ≥ 7:1 contrast.

nodes.label: Simple mode «وضع مبسّط» (one colloquial question per screen)
nodes.rationale: Principle 3: the worker's language: Egyptian colloquial questions, pictograms beside numbers and workers' units (شيكارة, جردل, قصعة, عربية يد); a truck mixer is always «خلاطة», never «عربية».

nodes.label: «طريقة الحساب» show-the-working trace
nodes.rationale: Principle 4: exact, traceable maths: pure engines in integer mm or full float, rounding only for display; every result expands into formula, inputs with units, clause, profile and confidence; defaults carry an «افتراضي» chip.

nodes.label: Versioned code profiles (<code>-<scope>@<n>)
nodes.rationale: Principle 5: code profiles, never constants. Profile ids are immutable (a value change makes @n+1) and documents snapshot the constants they used, so a reprint years later prints the same figures after an OTA engine fix.

nodes.label: Issue «إصدار» freezes outputs, checks and trace
nodes.rationale: At issue the document freezes {outputs, checks, trace} with the engine version and project/profile snapshots; report builders read frozen data and never recompute; later changes go into a new revision.

nodes.label: Issuer title block «خرطوشة»
nodes.rationale: Principle 7: paper the consultant accepts: the title block belongs to the issuer (underlined cell, PDF Author), never EngSpace.

nodes.label: Project profile ToolProject (one profile for every title block)
nodes.rationale: Principle 8: parties, logos, signatories and numbering typed once and reused by every tool. No money field by design, so supervisors can create and edit projects; the snapshot is copied into a document at issue.

nodes.label: No double entry principle
nodes.rationale: Principle 9: the diary assembles itself from today's pours, talks, permits and inspections; take-offs feed the material request; the level book feeds drain-run inverts.

nodes.label: Role gate src/tools/gate.ts (toolAllowed / stackAllowed / toolKindsForRole)
nodes.rationale: Principle 10: role rules are structural. A registry-derived allow-list replaces the deny-list hole: supervisors see no money, HR only the CV review. One gate at six call sites, pinned by a source test; parseHash stays syntactic.

nodes.label: No-money token test and money naming rule
nodes.rationale: Splits keys on camelCase/_ and fails on money tokens (price, rate, cost, amount, egp, fee, wage, salary, ...) or «ج.م». It replaced a substring regex that failed on costImpact, generatedAt, governorate and missed wage/fee; flow and spray rates carry units (flowLs, sprayLm2). Note: §5e's invariant list still quotes the old regex.

nodes.label: Wave 1 ships over the air on native line 2
nodes.rationale: Principle 11: wave 1 is JS, CSS, fonts and wasm only, so nativeLine stays 2; native extras (GPS, text-to-speech, Downloads) wait for line 3 with the production keystore.

nodes.label: Honest limits (calculators switch off rather than extrapolate)
nodes.rationale: Principle 12: e.g. excavation deeper than 6.1 m, a gas test outside its window; every PDF states what it is not.

nodes.label: Workforce quick tools pack (workforce)
Structural & concrete pack (structural)
Rebar pack (rebar)
Survey pack (survey)
Quantities & finishes pack (quantities)
HSE & site management pack (hse)
MEP-mechanical pack (mechanical)
Electrical pack (electrical)
Architecture pack (architecture)
Technical office pack «المكتب الفني» (office)
nodes.rationale: Holds the non-money office tools and is open to supervisors (§2, §5e type). Note: §5e Tools tab text renders «المكتب الفني والعقود» only with money access, contradicting that.

nodes.label: Contracts & payments pack «العقود والمستخلصات» 💲 (contracts)
nodes.rationale: Money pack: renders only with money access; entries carry money: true.

nodes.label: Salary & offers pack «الراتب والعروض» 💲 (money)
nodes.rationale: Money pack; the Home goal card uses t.pack === 'money', never 'not site'.

nodes.label: Material request «طلب خامات» (MR, kind materialRequest)
nodes.rationale: Lines from any trade-kit mode plus zone, element, needed-by date and requester; signed by the engineer; no price column ever.

nodes.label: Crew roster (kind crew, one per project)
Remnant store «مخزن البواقي» (kind rebarStock, per project)
nodes.rationale: Plans tag remnants R-01, R-02... so steel fixers can chalk them; a plan reserves the remnants it uses and releases them when recomputed.

nodes.label: Trade-kit tiles beyond civil (electrician, plumber, drywall, structural steel)
nodes.rationale: Electricians, plumbers, HVAC technicians, drywall fixers and steel fabricators are a large share of foremen, so four tiles ship with the MEP checks in Phase 4, each with simple mode and a no-price schema.

nodes.label: BS 8666:2020 shape codes and cut-length formulas (incl. shape 99)
nodes.rationale: Shape 99 uses the exact centre-line deduction; the old 2(r+d)-per-bend form made 45° cranks 112.5 mm short. Radius from BS 8666 Table 2, else 2d (≤16) / 3.5d (>16) so Ø18 never falls on the small mandrel. The BS formula rounded up governs.

nodes.label: 12 m cutting optimiser (FFD/BFD + Gilmore–Gomory column generation + branch-and-bound)
nodes.rationale: Web Worker, 300 ms per diameter, deterministic seed; lexicographic objective (new bars, scrap, remnant count, longest remnant); «أمثل» printed only when newBars = max(LB, ⌈LP⌉) because an optimality claim must be provable.

nodes.label: Development and lap length Ld (bbsLd, ECP 203)
nodes.rationale: Lap = 1.3·Ld because wave-1 splices are not staggered; η = 1.3 when position is unknown (conservative); plain grades and non-ECP profiles get a typed lap with its source.

nodes.label: Two-peg collimation test «اختبار الوتدين»
Misclosure allowance presets (12√K, 4√K, 24√K, 5√n, project, 6√K)
nodes.rationale: Distribution of the misclosure is refused («أعد الميزانية») when the run fails; 6√K is labelled a data point, not an ESA rule.

nodes.label: Pour planner logistics (Q_eff, trucks, interval, fleet, duration)
nodes.rationale: Q_eff = min(pump, plant, crew) with the governing factor named; waste applied once per element; the arrival schedule is the table the site actually works from.

nodes.label: Cold-joint guard A_max = Q_eff·t_cover/layer
Cube sampling plan (perVolume / first50then100)
nodes.rationale: Results are recorded, never judged: no acceptance verdict in v1.

nodes.label: Striking, curing and cube-test calendar
Truck log «سجل الخلاطات» (pour-day ticket log)
Permit state machine (draft → authorised → active → suspended → closed | cancelled)
nodes.rationale: Nobody may rely on a draft: authorising needs the party names, a paper-signed confirmation and a passing gas test where needed; until is written only at authorisation, so a draft never shows «ساري».

nodes.label: Photo time stamping «⏱ شبكة» / «⏱ جهاز»
nodes.rationale: Burned-in time, project and zone; network clock when the server offset was measured within 12 h, else device clock, which mitigates clock tampering of diary evidence; GPS waits for line 3.

nodes.label: QA/QC store migration (idempotent import on every hydrate)
nodes.rationale: Old inspections/qcTemplates keys merge by id while they exist; the imported flag is per device because during staged rollout an old-bundle phone keeps writing the old key; fixes the resurrection bug.

nodes.label: tradeKit · حاسبة الصنايعي (Trade quick kit)
nodes.rationale: Answers the foreman's daily questions in seconds in workers' units with per-member bucket and wheelbarrow calibration; lines feed a material request; never shows prices; absorbs the old masonry tool.

nodes.label: concrete · حصر وصب الخرسانة (Concrete take-off & pour planner)
nodes.rationale: Keeps the old id; a take-off groups up to 400 elements into pours that spawn pour plans; precedence order prevents double counting and waste is applied once per element (conc.doubleWaste); the WhatsApp summary names the order quantity because the batch plant reads it as the order. Review switched the sloped footing to the prismoidal formula.

nodes.label: siteDiary · يومية الموقع (Daily site diary)
nodes.rationale: Contemporary record and claim evidence under FIDIC 20.1 / 20.2.3; done in under 5 minutes because it assembles itself and carries yesterday's crew over; no money field; consultant signature means receipt only.

nodes.label: toolboxTalk · التوعية الصباحية وتمام المهمات (Toolbox talk & PPE muster)
nodes.rationale: Records the pre-start talk and PPE muster in under 2 minutes; a worker missing PPE needs an action; the topic library is reviewed by an HSE engineer before release.

nodes.label: bbs · جدول تفريد وقص الحديد (Bar bending schedule & 12 m cutting optimiser)
nodes.rationale: A BBS that names its code; steel fixers cut from it daily and the waste the optimiser saves is real tonnage.

nodes.label: checklists · قوائم الفحص والاستلام (QA/QC checklists & inspections)
nodes.rationale: Kept; inspectionPdf becomes qcReportSpec → DocSpec as the document kit's first consumer; inspections and user checklists move into the tool store as kinds inspection / qcTemplate, which gives them tombstones.

nodes.label: levelBook · دفتر الميزانية (Levelling field book + two-peg test)
nodes.rationale: Offline book checked as you type; raw readings change only through the audit after a 5-minute grace; the PDF is the «رفع مشترك» joint-survey sheet; integer mm.

nodes.label: workPermit · تصاريح العمل (Permit-to-work with safety calculators)
nodes.rationale: HSG250-style permit; the signed paper permit is the reference and the app state is for tracking; only authorised or active permits reach the diary and Today strip.

nodes.label: cableCheck · الكابل وهبوط الجهد (Cable & voltage-drop check)
nodes.rationale: The IEC ampacity transcription is unverified, so each circuit picks the bundled table or the maker's catalogue and the bases never mix; unverified passes print «ضمن الحد ⚑». The temperature table follows the method (B.52.15 ground for D1/D2, B.52.14 air otherwise) because buried circuits were derated as if in air.

nodes.label: acInstall · فحص تركيب التكييف (AC installation check)
nodes.rationale: Line sizes are never defaulted: they always come from the unit's manual; the HP label is never used in calculations.

nodes.label: drainRun · مناسيب غرف التفتيش (Drain run invert schedule + sight rails)
nodes.rationale: Ground levels can come from a levelBook document so they are typed once; integer mm levels.

nodes.label: sprinklerCheck · توزيع وفحص الرشاشات (Sprinkler count & spacing check)
nodes.rationale: Site area per head = max(sx, 2·wallX) × max(sy, 2·wallY) so an edge head cannot pass on head spacing alone; ECP profile ships disabled; banner «ليست حسابات هيدروليكية».

nodes.label: units · تحويل الوحدات والمساحات (Units, slopes & shapes)
nodes.rationale: Kept and extended; new exports use the unitx prefix so they cannot shadow CONVERT / convert in the test harness.

nodes.label: masonry · حصر المباني (legacy tool merged into tradeKit)
nodes.rationale: Old names stay in registry keywords with a «سريع» chip so muscle memory survives the move.

nodes.label: rebar · أوزان الحديد (legacy weight calculator, alias of bbs)
nodes.rationale: TOOL_ALIASES rebar → bbs keeps old opens working; results must equal rebarOrder() from site-calc.ts.

nodes.label: wallTakeoff · حصر المباني والبياض (Masonry & plaster take-off)
nodes.rationale: Multi-wall take-off the office prices and certifies; reuses tradeMasonry / tradePlaster; automatic lintels.

nodes.label: takeoffSheet · كشف الحصر (Measurement / take-off sheet)
nodes.rationale: Dimension sheet behind every certified quantity; no rates, open to supervisors; backs every IPC line.

nodes.label: finishTakeoff · حصر التشطيبات (Room-based finishes take-off)
fieldDensity · الكثافة الحقلية (Field density & compaction QC)
nodes.rationale: A test above the zero-air-voids density is invalid and never 'accepted'.

nodes.label: coolingLoad · حمل التبريد واختيار الوحدات (Cooling load & unit selection)
nodes.rationale: Quick mode returns a watermarked range; detailed CLTD always runs the dehumidification case because Cairo's peak dry-bulb point gives a negative outdoor-air latent load.

nodes.label: snagList · قائمة الملاحظات (Snag / punch list)
heatStress · الإجهاد الحراري وحظر الظهيرة (Heat index & midday-ban planner)
crewPlanner · تخطيط العمالة والمدة (Crew size & duration planner)
nodes.rationale: Days and heads only; the productivity field is outputPerDay, never rate; recalibrates from the member's own diaries.

nodes.label: cubeLog · سجل مكعبات الخرسانة (Concrete cube register)
nodes.rationale: No acceptance verdict while ECP's two criteria are unverified; due tests appear in the Today strip, no OS notifications.

nodes.label: hotConcrete · حرارة الخرسانة صيفًا (Fresh-concrete temperature planner)
lapLength · التماسك والوصلات (Development & lap length)
earthworks · الحفر والردم والنقل (Earthworks)
trench · خنادق المواسير (Pipe trench, pipes, manholes, dewatering)
pavement · كميات طبقات الرصف (Pavement layer quantities)
traverse · المضلعات والإحداثيات (Bearings, traverse, area & feddan)
setOut · التوقيع المساحي (Setting-out sheet)
stairCheck · السلالم والقائمات المنفذة (Stair design & as-built riser check)
liftPlan · خطة الرفع المبسطة (Lift plan)
nodes.rationale: Crane capacity is typed from the chart at the next larger radius; charts are never stored or interpolated; U > 100 % blocks.

nodes.label: scaffoldTags · بطاقات السقالات والسلالم (Scaffold, ladder & harness tags)
weeklyReport · التقرير الأسبوعي والشهري (Weekly / monthly roll-up)
incident · الحوادث ومؤشرات السلامة (Incident report + TRIR/LTIFR)
nodes.rationale: Health data is sensitive under PDPL 151/2020: an anonymised PDF, counts only in the diary, nothing pushed or posted.

nodes.label: extinguishers · طفايات الحريق (Extinguisher count & register)
detectors · توزيع الكواشف (Detector & call-point spacing)
fireDemand · الطلب المائي للحريق (Sprinkler demand & fire tank, preliminary)
ventilation · التهوية والشفط (Outdoor air & exhaust)
ductSizer · مقاسات الدكت (Duct sizer, equal friction)
nodes.rationale: Fitting losses and fan static pressure are engineer inputs because ASHRAE fitting data is licensed.

nodes.label: waterTank · الطلب المائي والخزانات (Water demand & tank sizing)
pumpSize · المضخات (Transfer / booster pump sizing)
panelSchedule · جدول اللوحة (Panel / load schedule)
lighting · الإنارة (Lumen-method lighting)
earthing · التأريض واختبار المقاومة (Earth-rod design & test record)
nodes.rationale: Only λ(n = 3) is confirmed; other λ values are flagged and never extrapolated.

nodes.label: rampAccess · المنحدرات والإتاحة (Ramps & accessibility)
ipc · المستخلص الجاري 💲 (Interim payment certificate)
nodes.rationale: BOQ imported from XLSX/CSV/TSV because nobody types 300 lines on a phone; current = cumulative − previous in integer piastres so rounding never drifts; claimed vs certified; dated, sourced tax rates; certified IPCs are frozen.

nodes.label: voRegister · سجل الأوامر التغييرية 💲 (Variation order register)
subStatement · مستخلص مقاول الباطن 💲 (Subcontractor statement)
irRegister · سجل طلبات الاستلام (IR / WIR / MIR register)
rfiLog · سجل الاستفسارات والاعتمادات (RFI, submittal & transmittal register)
meetingMinutes · محضر اجتماع (Meeting minutes)
dayworkSheet · يوميات الأعمال الإضافية (Daywork sheet, no rates)
steelTakeoff · حصر الحديد الإنشائي (Structural steel take-off)
curveSetOut · توقيع المنحنيات (Horizontal curve setting-out)
areaSchedule · جدول المساحات والاشتراطات (Area schedule, zoning & parking)
nodes.rationale: Moved to the first wave-2 batch because offices use it daily; no hard-coded limits, every limit typed from the permit.

nodes.label: finalAccount · الحساب الختامي 💲 (Final account)
bearingTest · قراءة اختبارات التحمل (CBR / DCP / plate-load reader)
nodes.rationale: The engine refuses to output an allowable bearing pressure.

nodes.label: kerbs · البردورات والإنترلوك (Kerbs & interlock)
gridCheck · أنظمة الإحداثيات المصرية (ETM / UTM belts & scale factors)
nodes.rationale: Projection within one datum only; any datum transformation for setting out is refused.

nodes.label: supplyPipe · مواسير التغذية (WSFU supply pipe sizing)
drainSize · مقاسات الصرف والتهوية (DFU drainage & vent sizing)
chwPipe · مواسير المياه المثلجة (Chilled-water pipe sizing)
firePump · مضخة الحريق والجوكي (Standpipe, fire & jockey pump)
emergencyLight · إنارة الطوارئ والهروب (Emergency lighting & exit signs)
septicGrease · خزان التحليل والجريز (Septic tank & grease interceptor)
rainwater · صرف الأمطار (Roof rainwater)
shortCircuit · تيار القصر (Short-circuit at a panel)
pfCorrection · تحسين معامل القدرة (Power-factor correction)
genUps · المولد والـ UPS (Generator & UPS sizing)
lowCurrent · التيار الخفيف (Low-current quick checks)
openings · جدول الفتحات والإضاءة والتهوية (Openings schedule & room register)
egress · حمل الإشغال والهروب (Occupant load & egress width)
ncr · تقرير عدم المطابقة (Non-conformance report)
rcSection · مقاومة القطاعات الخرسانية (RC section check, ECP 203)
nodes.rationale: High liability: ships disabled until the ECP 203 text is supplied and a licensed structural engineer signs the vectors.

nodes.label: delayPenalty · غرامات التأخير 💲 (Delay penalty)
priceAdjust · فروق الأسعار 💲 (Price adjustment)
rateAnalysis · تحليل سعر البند 💲 (Unit-rate build-up)
siteBook · دفتر الموقع (Site instruction book) [L ⚑]
Salary & offer tools (offer, net, compare, script, raise, path, contract, move, inflation)
nodes.rationale: Kept unchanged as sheets, now explicitly registered with pack: 'money', money: true.

nodes.label: cvreview · مراجعة السيرة الذاتية (CV review, the only HR tool)
Tool routes #app/tool/<id>, #app/tooldoc/<id>:<docId|new>, toolprojects, toolstorage, v
app.replaceTop(e): swaps tooldoc/<id>:new for the real id
nodes.rationale: So a reload, an OTA restart or a renderer loss reopens the same draft, never a blank one.

nodes.label: ToolDoc envelope (kind, v, lang, engine, frozen, profile, body, photos, log, audit)
nodes.rationale: audit is never truncated (above 500 entries a new revision is required); unknown fields are preserved so an older bundle never strips newer data; a newer v opens read-only.

nodes.label: Engine contract (Conf, Check, TraceStep, <PREFIX>_ENGINE)
nodes.rationale: Pure engines never throw on input (the smoke crawl types «12345» everywhere) and return {...outputs, checks, trace}; units are in the names (lenM, dMm, pumpM3h).

nodes.label: Engine-version hash pin (tests/tools/engine-versions.test.ts)
nodes.rationale: Fails when vector outputs change and <PREFIX>_ENGINE was not bumped.

nodes.label: Calculation-basis block {k:'basis'} on every calculation PDF
Test tolerance policy (compare at printed decimals)
nodes.rationale: A pin should fail only on a visible change: toBeCloseTo at the printed decimals plus an exact check at 1e-4 relative.

nodes.label: Discipline disclaimers and wording rules (§8.1)
nodes.rationale: Printed at 8/12 above the signatures where it is read; no Egyptian-code compliance claim unless the profile is active and verified; EngSpace never issuer, approver or checker; no ads, paywall or 'official' claim.

nodes.label: WhatsApp summary summary(doc, lang)
nodes.rationale: Type · number · Rev · status, ≤ 4 KPIs, then «تقدير — راجع المستند الكامل»; Latin and number runs wrapped in LRI/PDI so they survive any chat app; required for every tool that saves documents.

nodes.label: Document kit src/doc (DocSpec → docLayout → backends)
nodes.rationale: One pure-data model, several backends; page count known before drawing so each page is drawn, encoded and released in one pass; report builders are pure (doc, project) → DocSpec, testable in Node; renderDoc never rejects.

nodes.label: Raster backend (240 dpi, lossless 4-bit indexed Flate pages)
nodes.rationale: A greyscale-plus-accent theme makes 16 inks exact, so pages are lossless with no JPEG smudge; JPEG fallback if the worker fails; ≤ 300 KB per dense page and ≤ 1.2 s per page on Pixel 7 at 4x throttle.

nodes.label: Vector backend (harfbuzz wasm + bidi-js + hb-subset, Phase 5)
nodes.rationale: Selectable, searchable text on line 2; wasm fetched then instantiated (never instantiateStreaming) because the Capacitor server and OTA path may serve .wasm without application/wasm; default only after a five-point gate.

nodes.label: EngPdf native print plugin (deliberately not built)
nodes.rationale: Would need native line 3 and a different path per platform; the vector backend gives vector output on line 2, on the web and in Node tests from one deterministic path.

nodes.label: Running header and one-line EngSpace footer
nodes.rationale: The 7 pt «أُعدّ باستخدام EngSpace» line with the E+S mark is the only EngSpace attribution; «منصة المهندسين الرسمية» removed.

nodes.label: Colophon (technical data only: profiles, engines, SHA-256)
Paged tables with «يُرحّل / ما قبله» carry-forward rows
Report typography: IBM Plex Sans Arabic subsets (450/600/700)
nodes.rationale: Arabic never below 9 pt in tables; Latin digits because Plex's Arabic-Indic digits are not tabular; subsets committed so the build never runs Python.

nodes.label: DocPreview (same display list and layout object as export)
Export memory rules (≤ 2 live page canvases, no base64)
nodes.rationale: Prevents WebView renderer death on long exports; the only base64 is the native file write, chunked at 524,286 bytes (a multiple of 3) so no padding lands mid-file.

nodes.label: PDF delivery src/doc/deliver.ts (deliverPdf, shareSummary)
nodes.rationale: Plugins destructured from awaited modules, every call under withTimeout; 'Share canceled' resolves cancelled with no toast.

nodes.label: Excel & CSV export (docXlsx / docCsv)
Document numbering <code>-<orig>-<TYPE>-<NNNN> (ISO 19650 option)
nodes.rationale: The originator means two engineers on one project never both issue NAC-DR-0001; counters are editable; offline collisions are flagged «رقم مكرر» at merge.

nodes.label: Document hash and fingerprint «بصمة المستند»
nodes.rationale: Wave 1 prints 16 hex instead of a QR that would only verify on the issuer's phone; crypto.subtle is undefined on plain HTTP (LAN phone preview), hence the sha256hex fallback.

nodes.label: Public verification: doc_receipts, QR and #app/v/<docId> (Phase 4b)
nodes.rationale: doc_receipts holds only {id, hash, issued_at} behind a rate-limited security-definer lookup; the signed-out page shows only number, revision, date and match / no match.

nodes.label: Media limits and photo upload pacing (media_register, my_media_usage())
nodes.rationale: 30 uploads / 10 min, 300 / day, 100 MB per member would fill within months and an offline backlog would hit 54000, so the queue sends ≤ 25 per 10 min and the inspection kind total rises to 500 MB.

nodes.label: Tool document store (IndexedDB first, member_state shards, outbox)
nodes.rationale: Principle 6: drafts never die. Every keystroke autosaves to IndexedDB; stores are created at version 1 and never bumped because an OTA rollback would fail with VersionError; runs in memory with a banner if IndexedDB is unavailable.

nodes.label: member_state shards (toolIndex, toolShelfA…X, toolProjects, toolPrefs)
nodes.rationale: member_state allows 40 keys and 1 MB per value; 24 shards x 700 KB ≈ 16.8 MB of bodies per member.

nodes.label: toolPrefs (synced: calibrations, disclaimer acks, default profiles, lastOpen)
toolDevice per-device preferences (active project, field/sun/simple mode)
nodes.rationale: These would overwrite each other between phones and spend server writes if synced; not in PANE_KEYS.

nodes.label: Caps and size guards (jsonbBytes measures the server jsonb form)
nodes.rationale: jsonb text adds a space after every : and , so dense shards measure 10–25 % more on the server; over a cap saving is refused with a reason, never sliced.

nodes.label: Per-document merge toolMerge (conflict copies, tombstones)
nodes.rationale: Two-sided edits keep the remote id and turn the local copy into «(نسخة متعارضة)»; nothing is overwritten.

nodes.label: Offline-first write path (debounce, token bucket, verify-after-write)
nodes.rationale: Per-key debounce, ≤ 120 tool writes / 10 min and ≤ 1,500 / day; the next hydrate verifies the shard really holds the write, closing the whole-value last-writer-wins hole.

nodes.label: Tool hydrate (loadAll excludes tool%, stamps first, then changed shards)
nodes.rationale: Otherwise every hydrate would download all 24 shards (~21 MB) and stall the feed; tool loading runs in its own try/catch.

nodes.label: Write-ahead journal (Directory.Data/tools-journal)
nodes.rationale: WebKit can purge website data under storage pressure, so dirty documents and photos are journaled and replayed at boot.

nodes.label: Delete flow: tombstone, 6 s undo, photos removed after sync
Account deletion wipes the device store (toolStore.destroy)
nodes.rationale: deleteAccount only reset memory; destroy removes the IndexedDB database, PDF cache and journal, keeping the rule that deleting an account deletes everything it wrote.

nodes.label: Storage meter «التخزين» (bodies, photos, device archive, JSON backup)
member_state_b_rate trigger (private.limit_writes, before insert)
nodes.rationale: Before insert only: an upsert fires both BEFORE INSERT and BEFORE UPDATE triggers, so an insert-or-update trigger would count every upsert twice.

nodes.label: tool_docs table with save_tool_doc (conflict-returning, Phase 4b)
nodes.rationale: Arrives with the IPC, which needs history, capacity and sharing; moves the merge to the server; shard copies verified first.

nodes.label: Tool UI kit ui/kit (NumField … ExportBar)
NumField (type=text, inputMode=decimal, ± key, unit required)
nodes.rationale: Accepts Arabic-Indic digits and U+2212; unit has no default because today's Field defaults to «ج.م»; empty gives null and results show «—», never 0.

nodes.label: KitStepper (− value +, long-press repeat, haptic tick)
nodes.rationale: Named KitStepper because features/admin/kit.tsx already exports Stepper and the harness merges every export.

nodes.label: RowEditor (windowed card/grid editor, paste from Excel)
nodes.rationale: Card mode by default to fit a 360 px phone; no drag or swipe; only the edited row re-renders.

nodes.label: ResultCard (hero number, pictograms, «طريقة الحساب»)
ConfirmDialog (src/ui/confirm.tsx, main chunk)
nodes.rationale: Replaces three inline copies; main chunk because ui/feed.tsx and other main-chunk screens use it.

nodes.label: DocList (windowed list of saved documents)
ExportBar (sticky .foot: معاينة · تصدير PDF · مشاركة)
Toast action store key toastAction (6 s undo button)
nodes.rationale: app.toast is the bare setter setMsg called at ~60 sites, so a new store key carries the button and old calls stay.

nodes.label: Test-harness constraints (smoke crawl, stub React, no top-level side effects)
Tool registry TOOL_REGISTRY (pure data, no imports)
nodes.rationale: No imports so taxonomy can import it without a cycle and Playwright's loader can generate e2e tests from it; money: true never lists supervisor; aliases resolve old ids.

nodes.label: app.openTool(id): the single tool opener
nodes.rationale: Resolves aliases, checks toolAllowed, then routes by surface, so no caller opens an empty sheet once site tools leave TOOL_VIEWS.

nodes.label: TOOL_ICONS explicit lucide named imports
nodes.rationale: The vitest lucide stub only stubs named imports, and a dynamic icons[name] lookup would pull the whole set into the main chunk.

nodes.label: Tools tab ToolsTab (Today strip, search, «الأخيرة», packs)
Lazy tool chunks with gzip budgets (scripts/bundle-budget.mjs)
nodes.rationale: Site tools leave the main chunk; the office money chunk is never requested for supervisors; CI fails a chunk > 10 % over budget.

nodes.label: Tools i18n plan (Arabic in code, English TSV 52–61, split tool dictionary)
nodes.rationale: Tool strings would bloat the statically imported English dictionary, so they go to en.tools.generated.json registered on first tool open; an i18n-complete test enforces English; member text is never translated.

nodes.label: Unique engine export prefixes (trade, conc, bbs/cut, lvl, diary, tbt, ptw, acx, drn, spk, cab, unitx)
nodes.rationale: The harness merges every export into one object, so a duplicate name would hide a broken engine.

nodes.label: E2E hooks data-tool=<id> generated from the registry
nodes.rationale: Arabic names are not stable selectors: «حصر الخرسانة» is not a substring of «حصر وصب الخرسانة».

nodes.label: Pending / disabled profiles «بانتظار المراجعة»
nodes.rationale: Selectable only as read-only preview; active only through a committed verification record in docs/PROFILES.md.

nodes.label: Owner actions (code texts and reviewers)
Tool document privacy (own rows only, workers' data under PDPL)
nodes.rationale: Never in feeds, profiles or search; staff have no reader; nothing pushed; photos private with EXIF stripped; verification is anonymous.
